lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: Momo, have you seen my telescope?
lines.direction: Ravi looks at Momo. Momo is nervous and glances at the sky.

lines.speaker: momo
lines.direction: Momo shrugs, then looks at the camera.

lines.speaker: ravi
lines.text: The one sticking out behind your back.
lines.direction: Ravi points at Momo. When Ravi says 'back', Momo does a double take.

lines.speaker: momo
lines.direction: After the line Momo scratches their head, then Ravi gives a long stare.
